title: Reconstruction Draw Schedule Exhibit: Milestones, Deposit Cap, Retainage and Draw Terms by Agreement
content:
Every Reconstruction agreement bills the contract in draws at the milestones of its own draw schedule. The percentage shown against a milestone is the share of the current contract sum billed at that milestone, and the percentages of one agreement total 100.

## Draw milestones and percentages

| Agreement | Contract signing | Framing complete | Rough-in complete | Drywall complete | Finishes complete | Substantial completion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | 30% | — | — | — | — | 70% |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | 10% | — | 30% | 30% | — | 30% |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | 10% | — | 25% | 25% | 25% | 15% |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | 10% | 20% | 20% | 20% | 20% | 10% |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | 20% | — | — | 40% | — | 40% |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | 10% | — | 30% | 30% | — | 30% |

A dash means the milestone is not part of that agreement's schedule.

## Deposit cap, retainage and draw terms

The deposit cap limits the contract signing draw whatever its percentage, in US dollars. The retainage percentage is the share withheld from each draw payment until retainage release. The retainage release days are the calendar days after substantial completion when the retainage draw may be requested. The draw due days are the calendar days after a draw request by which the draw is due from a self-paying customer.

| Agreement | Deposit cap | Retainage | Retainage release days | Draw due days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | $3000.00 | 0% | 0 | 7 |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | $5000.00 | 0% | 0 | 10 |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | $15000.00 | 0% | 0 | 10 |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | $25000.00 | 5% | 30 | 10 |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | $10000.00 | 0% | 0 | 15 |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | $50000.00 | 10% | 45 | 30 |

## Lien waivers and mortgagee inspection

| Agreement | Conditional lien waiver with each draw request | Mortgagee inspection before a loss-draft draw |
|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | No | Yes |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | Yes | Yes |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | Yes | Yes |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | Yes | Yes |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | Yes | Yes |

The lien waiver column states whether a conditional lien waiver accompanies each draw request. The mortgagee column states whether a draw funded by a mortgagee loss-draft release must follow a mortgagee inspection of the completed milestone.

## Notes on reading the exhibit

- Only the Full Structural Rebuild Agreement and the Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement withhold retainage; on every other agreement the retainage percentage and the retainage release days are 0.
- The deposit cap applies only to the contract signing draw. Example with hypothetical figures: on an agreement whose signing percentage is 10% and whose deposit cap were $4,000.00, a current contract sum of $62,000.00 gives 10% of $62,000.00, that is $6,200.00, which the cap holds to $4,000.00.
